question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 9.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Complications **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given words. 
 
 
• **Complicated** = If you say that something is complicated, you mean it has so many parts or aspects that it is difficult to understand or deal with.
 
• **Complicating** = It is the gerund of Complicate and it is used to make things or situations complex or difficult.
 
• **Complications** = A complication is a problem or difficulty that makes a situation harder to deal with. Complications generally involve a worsening in the severity of the disease.
 
• **Complicates** = It is used when referring to 3rd person present form.
 
 
 
• As per the usage of the given words **"complications****"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **"He passed away as a result of coronavirus complications."**

Hence, the correct answer is: option 3.
